'''Braised bruallki brisket''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> made from the herd [[Species/Legends|animal]] [[bruallki]].<ref name="Jade Solitaire">{{StoryCite|story=Jade Solitaire|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> The dish was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It cost 8.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served on [[Taungsday/Legends|Taungsdays]] as part of the diner's [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate specials]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Braised bruallki brisket was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
